title: GlobalAchievements
description: A cooperative Minecraft event plugin that makes advancements global, adds a shared 3-day challenge timer, global stats, and rewards or punishes the entire server based on the outcome.
body:
## 🌍 GlobalAchievements – Server-Wide Event Plugin

**GlobalAchievements** is a cooperative Minecraft server event plugin that turns regular advancements into a **global, shared challenge** for all players.

Instead of each player completing advancements individually, **every advancement counts globally for the entire server**. The goal is simple: **complete all advancements before the event timer ends**.

---

## ⏳ Global Event System

- A shared **3-day countdown timer** starts the event
- All players contribute to the same advancement progress
- Progress is shown live using a clean **sidebar scoreboard**
- The event outcome affects **everyone on the server**

---

## 📊 Shared Global Statistics

The plugin tracks and displays global server statistics in real time:
- Total advancements completed
- Total player deaths
- Total mobs killed
- Remaining time until the event ends

Everything is synchronized and shared between all players.

---

## 🏆 Victory & Punishment Mechanics

### ✅ If players WIN the event:
- All advancements are completed before the timer ends
- Every player receives **Luck III**
- **Ore blocks drop triple resources** for 24 hours
- Perfect for rewarding teamwork and coordination

### ❌ If players LOSE the event:
- The world becomes **cursed** for 24 hours
- Monster spawn rates increase dramatically
- Mobs gain extra health and combat effects
- Survival becomes significantly harder

---

## ⚙️ Features

- Global shared advancements
- Time-limited cooperative challenge
- Live scoreboard UI
- Server-wide rewards or punishments
- No client mods required
- Fully server-side plugin
- Works on **Paper / Purpur**
- Designed for survival and hardcore-style events

---

## 🎯 Perfect For

- SMP servers
- Hardcore events
- Community challenges
- Content creator servers
- Short-term competitive survival events

---

**GlobalAchievements** turns Minecraft into a true cooperative challenge where **everyone wins together — or suffers together**.
